chunks: Whosoever is the enemy of God and His angels and apostles, and of Gabriel and Michael, then God is the enemy of such unbelievers.
ai.seo_question: Who are the enemies of God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the specific roles of Jibril and Mika'il as archetypes of divine messengers, reinforcing the concept of divine enmity towards those who reject the core tenets of revelation. The mention of these two angels underscores their pivotal status in Islamic cosmology and their role in delivering the Quranic message, linking their enmity directly to the broader category of disbelievers (kuffar). This establishes a theological framework where opposition to the messengers is synonymous with opposition to God's will.
